description: Cresto Techno Limited designs and develops Ignitium Energy OS, an operating system for energy infrastructure management. The company's platform manages fuel, electricity, solar, storage, electric vehicles, and hydrogen through a unified interface. It serves India's energy infrastructure sector. Cresto Techno Limited was formerly known as Silly Monks Entertainment Limited and changed its name to Cresto Techno Limited in September 2026. Cresto Techno Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
